prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished main menu background for the existing After333 pixel-art fantasy card-battle game, landscape 1920x1080, widescreen 16:9. This is background artwork, not a screenshot or UI mockup.
Primary request: create an attractive, polished game start screen background with the exact readable logo "After333" at the SCREEN CENTER. Keep existing game's rich pixel-art landscape style and gold/cyan brand palette.
Scene/backdrop: three civilizations gently converge into one coherent valley: left a lush ancient magical forest with a subtle blue portal and distant fantasy towers; right misty East Asian mountains, bamboo and graceful martial-arts temple rooftops; far middle distance a refined bronze-and-dark-steel science city with restrained blue power lights and a little amber glow. A weathered circular stone plaza in the foreground, soft atmospheric depth. Clear deliberate pixel clusters and painterly pixel-art lighting, premium detailed game key art. No people or foreground characters.
Logo: EXACT spelling and case "After333", ONE horizontal line, no space, no subtitle. Gold beveled "After", luminous cyan-blue "333", crisp elegant fantasy lettering, a restrained dark bronze backing/outline for readability. Compact tasteful small blue crystal accents. Text must read at a glance. Center the actual wordmark at normalized x=0.50,y=0.50. Keep the whole logo including ornaments confined approximately x=0.33..0.67 and y=0.43..0.57 (650x150 canvas units). No giant tall round crest. Logo must not move to the top of the picture. Optional very small three-card fan above the wordmark with abstract magic/temple/gear emblems, but do not let it overwhelm the exact centered wordmark.
Composition: visual detail on left/right edges and distant upper background; graceful framing, not three separate panels. Below 60% image height, the central region x=0.32..0.68 must be QUIET dark blue-gray stone and soft shadow with very low contrast for the game's existing menu buttons. No bright orb, character, fire or text in that lower central region. Keep important logo fully in the middle horizontal safe region, so mobile ratios can crop peripheral scenery. Upper corners moderately dark for account/currency UI readability.
Text (verbatim): "After333".
Constraints: full bleed finished background, opaque background; no drawn buttons, no fake menus, no interface frame, no watermarks, no extra writing, no Project333, no misspelled logo, no borders, no blur. Do not bake any gameplay controls into the image. Only the After333 logo is lettering.
